title: Logistic Regression + Evaluation Suite
blurb: Build a classifier and the metrics around it, all by hand.
brief: Implement binary logistic regression with NumPy, then write your own evaluation toolkit: confusion matrix, accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC curve and AUC, and stratified k-fold cross-validation. Use it to study how the decision threshold changes precision and recall on an imbalanced dataset.
requirements: Sigmoid, binary cross-entropy loss and gradient descent training, with probabilities clipped for numeric safety
fit, predict_proba and predict (with a configurable threshold)
Your own confusion matrix, precision, recall and F1 functions
ROC curve points and AUC computed without a library
Stratified k-fold cross-validation written by you
A threshold study on an imbalanced dataset with a plot or table
deliverables: A report showing metrics per fold and the threshold study
Tests comparing your metrics with known small examples
stretch: Add class weights and compare to resampling
resume_bullet: Built logistic regression and a full evaluation suite (ROC/AUC, stratified CV) from scratch, analyzing precision-recall trade-offs on imbalanced data.
